title: Lead Engineer- Network Modernization
description:
**The** **Opportunity:**
------------------------

Avantor is looking for the Lead Engineer- Network Modernization, reporting to the Manager, Data Network Services at Avantor, is responsible for building, implementing, and supporting enterprise network, infrastructure across LAN, WAN, and cloud environments. This role emphasizes translating architectural designs into deployable solutions, validating configurations, and ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable network operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

Network Design & Build Engineering:

* Translate high-level architecture into detailed, deployable network designs (low-level designs)
* Build, plan, and validate new network configurations and capabilities across LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, SD-WAN, and cloud environments
* Develop and maintain network diagrams, standards, and reusable design templates
* Contribute to capacity planning and scalability assessments

Implementation & Deployment:

* Lead implementation of network solutions aligned with enterprise architecture and corporate standards
* Lab-test and pilot new network services, hardware, and policies prior to production rollout
* Execute network upgrades, migrations, and deployments with minimal business disruption
* Coordinate closely with architecture and modernization teams to ensure smooth handoffs

Operations & Support:

* Troubleshoot complex network performance and connectivity issues across on-prem and remote environments
* Support and optimize remote access solutions including VPN and secure access technologies
* Manage build requests, implementation backlogs, and configuration changes
* Security & Compliance:
* Implement network security controls including firewalls, segmentation, and secure connectivity solutions
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security policies and industry standards
* Support vulnerability remediation, audits, and risk mitigation efforts

Collaboration & Documentation:

* Partner with cloud, infrastructure, and security teams to deliver integrated solutions
* Participate in technical design discussions and reviews
* Maintain accurate documentation of configurations, procedures, and standards

Success Metrics:

* Timely completion of network implementation plans
* Successful lab validation and pilot deployments
* Reduction in network-related incidents through proactive improvements
Number of reusable design templates and standardized configurations developed  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
10+ years of experience in network engineering or infrastructure roles.  

**Technical Expertise:**

* Strong understanding of core networking protocols: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP
* Routing & switching: hands-on experience with OSPF, BGP, and enterprise routing/switching across Cisco and HPE platforms
* WAN technologies: experience with Cisco SD-WAN and traditional WAN architectures
* Wireless networking: experience with Aruba Wireless and enterprise Wi-Fi deployments, Wireless Surveys, troubleshooting complex wireless related issues.
* Network security: strong knowledge of enterprise security principles including firewalls, segmentation, and access control
* Hands-on experience with security platforms and services such as Palo Alto firewalls, Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA), and secure access solutions
* Cloud networking: hands-on experience designing and implementing AWS VPC and Azure VNet architectures, including subnets, route tables, security groups, peering, NAT gateways, and hybrid connectivity (VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute)
* Experience with secure remote access and zero trust architectures (e.g., ZPA)
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills across complex, distributed network environment  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent (Routing & Switching, Enterprise, or Security)
* Experience with Cisco SD-WAN design, deployment, and operations in enterprise environments
* Exposure to Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) frameworks and secure access solutions (e.g., Zscaler ZIA/ZPA)
* Experience with network automation and scripting using tools such as Python or Ansible
* Familiarity with cloud-native security controls and advanced networking features in AWS and Azure
* Experience supporting large-scale, geographically distributed enterprise networks
* Exposure to load balancers, proxies, or application delivery technologies
* Tools & Technologies:
* Networking & Infrastructure: Cisco (routing, switching, SD-WAN), HPE, Juniper
* Wireless: Aruba Wireless solutions, Cisco Wireless.
* Security: Palo Alto firewalls, Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA), network segmentation and access control technologies
* Cloud Platforms: AWS (VPC), Azure (VNet), including hybrid connectivity (VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute)
* Remote Access & Zero Trust: VPN technologies, ZTNA solutions
* Automation (optional but preferred): Python, Ansible

* Documents and closes resolved incidents according to agreed procedures.

* Maintains knowledge of specific specialisms, provides detailed advice regarding their application.
* Provides continuous feedback to clients and affected parties and updates all systems, portals and ticketing tools as prescribed by standard operating procedures.

* Supports engineers during issues arising out of scheduled maintenance activities.
* Creates knowledge articles in incident diagnosis/resolution and assist with updating as and when required.
* Upgrades skills and enhance knowledge on latest products and technologies and complete required certification.
* Documents client solutions and knowledge sharing with the internal/external stakeholder
* Identifies operational/technical risks and provides suitable mitigation.
* Analyses and reviews repeat failures and works on permanent solution.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Advanced knowledge of technical documentation.
* Advanced knowledge on management agent concepts, redundancy concepts and remote console architecture within supported technical domain.
* Advanced knowledge of vendor technologies, such as Cisco, Microsoft, ARC, Audio Codes, PeterCOnnect, Sonus.
* Advanced problem solver who is highly driven and self-organized.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Excellent analytical and logical thinking.
* Excellent spoken and written communication skills.
* Team player with the ability to work well with others and in group with colleagues and stakeholders.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology or Computing or related field.
* Expert level Certification in different Security Technologies such as Cisco, Juniper, Checkpoint, PaloAlto, Fortinet, Aruba, BlueCoat, ZeeScaler 5 such as CCIE, JNCIE, ACCE, PCNSE, CCTE etc.

**Required experience:**

* Advanced experience in Security technologies such as Firewall, IPS, IDS, Proxy etc.
* Advanced experience in technical support to clients.
* Advanced experience in diagnosis and troubleshooting.
* Advanced experience providing remote support in Security technologies.
* Advanced experience in relevant technology.

title: Team Lead, Support Engineering
description:
As a **Team Lead, Support Engineering** at FloQast, you will lead a specialized team dedicated to delivering exceptional technical support for FloQast customers across the Accounting Workflow Automation Platform. Like all roles on the FloQast Support team, this is a hands-on leadership position. You will report to a Manager or Director of Support Engineering and run your team with a high degree of autonomy, balancing your time between hands-on work and people management, ensuring you remain a primary resource for your team while mentoring Technical Support Engineers to unblock customers effectively.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Lead a specialized team of Technical Support Engineers dedicated to unblocking customers through troubleshooting and technical administrative and configuration work across the FloQast Accounting Workflow Automation Platform.
* Own talent strategy for the team, including hiring, onboarding, training, 1:1 meetings, annual reviews, performance coaching, and career development.
* Oversee the team's work and collaborate asynchronously with US colleagues and leadership.
* Build and optimize processes such as routing work between teams, and drive improvements through AI, tooling, documentation, and data insights.
* Maintain strong proficiency in the FloQast platform, staying current with features and limitations, product updates, future roadmap, and best practices to effectively support both customers and the team.
* Remain hands-on with the team's work, including configuration requests, focusing your bandwidth where it can best help customers and the team.
* Leverage internal admin tools (Admin Portal) to execute CRUD operations in the database.
* Track and report on key Support metrics and queue health, including request volume and urgency, ensuring accurate prioritization, timely responses, and effective resolutions.
* Cultivate a high-performance culture rooted in our Support Values: Empathetic Helpers, Technical Problem Solvers, Trusted Product Experts, Generous Collaborators, and Thoughtful Communicators.
* Contribute to special projects and initiatives as assigned, leveraging expertise and a creative problem-solving skillset to help the department and company achieve its goals.

### **What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years of functional experience in Technical Support, IT operations, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 2+ years of people management experience, including hiring and onboarding.
* Demonstrated success in managing individual contributors in technical roles.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a team independently.
* Strong written communication skills and experience working with colleagues globally across multiple time zones.
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to quickly master complex products and rapidly evolving platform features.
* Proven ability to balance long-term strategic initiatives with day-to-day operational leadership.
* Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders on both operational initiatives and proactive improvements.

### **Nice to Haves**

* Relevant experience with the FloQast platform or comparable B2B fintech products.
* Degree in Business, IT, Computer Science, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* Professional experience or familiarity with principles in Accounting, Internal Audit, External Audit, Compliance, Finance, or related fields.
* Experience building or scaling a new team.
* Expertise and/or certifications in Zendesk administration.
* Familiarity with support automation strategies and AI support tools.
* Familiarity with tools like Jira, Grafana, and Highspot, and with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, other LLMs, and specialized support AI tooling.
* Experience supporting employees across distributed offices and/or remote locations, domestically and/or internationally.
* Exposure to Sales/Customer Success methodologies or frameworks that enhance retention and expansion.

title: Execution systems-Snr Eng
description:
**Job Summary**

Execute and enhance industrial data historian and execution systems by designing configuring and optimizing AVEVA PI based solutions for global manufacturing and supply chain operations in a hybrid work model. Collaborate with cross functional teams to ensure reliable data acquisition contextualization and analytics that improve efficiency quality and business decision making.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement robust AVEVA PI based execution system solutions that reliably collect store and contextualize high volume time series data from diverse plant floor sources to support manufacturing insights and decision making.
* Configure and maintain AVEVA PI interfaces connectors and calculation workflows to ensure accurate data flow from control systems instruments and external applications into the historian environment with minimal downtime.
* Develop advanced PI asset models events and analytics to transform raw operational signals into meaningful metrics that improve visibility of production performance quality trends and equipment health.
* Optimize execution system architectures by reviewing data flows tag configurations and storage strategies to improve system responsiveness scalability and long term maintainability.
* Collaborate with manufacturing and supply chain stakeholders to capture requirements translate process needs into technical specifications and deliver AVEVA PI driven solutions that address real operational challenges.
* Build and refine operational dashboards and self service data views using PI tools so that business users can independently monitor key performance indicators and respond quickly to process deviations.
* Provide expert troubleshooting and root cause analysis for AVEVA PI incidents by examining logs data patterns and configurations then implementing durable corrective actions that strengthen overall system reliability.
* Implement governance practices for tag naming data quality validation and system documentation to maintain consistency and traceability across multiple plants and execution environments.
* Coordinate with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams to align AVEVA PI components with enterprise standards for access control network segmentation and backup to protect critical operational data.
* Guide adoption of data driven practices in manufacturing and supply chain teams by explaining historian capabilities demonstrating use cases and promoting continuous improvement based on trusted data.
* Plan and execute system upgrades patches and migration activities for execution systems so that platforms remain supported secure and aligned with evolving business requirements.
* Estimate effort for enhancements prepare technical design documents and track progress so that execution system deliverables are completed on time and within defined quality expectations.
* Partner with external vendors and internal experts to evaluate new AVEVA PI features complementary tools and integration patterns that can expand the value of existing execution system investments.

**Qualifications**

* Possess a strong background in AVEVA PI Historian with hands on experience in configuration administration and solution development across at least one complex industrial environment.
* Bring eight to twelve years of overall experience in execution systems or related industrial software with a sustained focus on data historian technologies and operational data management.
* Demonstrate practical knowledge of manufacturing or supply chain domains by understanding production workflows material movements and typical plant metrics that benefit from historian insights.
* Apply solid skills in data modeling time series analytics and performance optimization so that historian solutions remain efficient even as tag counts and data volumes grow.
* Use clear communication and documentation abilities to work effectively with process engineers planners and business analysts in a hybrid work setting spanning onsite and remote collaboration.
* Exhibit proficiency in problem solving and incident resolution for complex system interactions involving historians control systems middleware and enterprise applications.
* Show familiarity with integration approaches that connect AVEVA PI with reporting tools analytics platforms or manufacturing execution systems to create end to end digital workflows.
* Display comfort working within structured delivery frameworks and change management practices to ensure safe deployment of modifications in regulated or high criticality operations.

description:

**Job Description: Service Engineer – Customer Support\_OIS (Software Support)**

We are looking for a skilled and customer-focused OIS Engineer to provide technical support, installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance of Oncology Information Systems (OIS) and associated IT infrastructure. The role involves supporting hospitals and cancer care centres to ensure system availability, minimize downtime, and maintain high customer satisfaction.

* Provide Level 1 and Level 2 technical support for OIS applications, servers, clients, and associated IT infrastructure.
* Troubleshoot Windows Server operating systems, databases, networking, hardware, and application-related issues.
* Support OIS installation, upgrades, migrations, configuration, and preventive maintenance activities.
* Monitor and resolve customer issues through remote support and onsite service visits, as required.
* Coordinate with Field Service Engineers, Application Specialists, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams to resolve technical issues.
* Perform proactive system health checks, identify potential risks, and recommend corrective actions to improve system reliability.
* Support server and client hardware replacement, operating system upgrades, backups, and disaster recovery activities.

* Working knowledge of server hardware, storage, networking, databases, and Windows client operating systems.
* Good analytical, problem-solving, communication, and customer-handling skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage service priorities effectively.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites when required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting healthcare IT applications, hospital information systems, or clinical systems.
* Knowledge of SQL Server, virtualization technologies, backup solutions, and enterprise server infrastructure.
* Experience with remote troubleshooting, incident management, and preventive maintenance.
* Relevant IT certifications or training in Microsoft technologies, networking, or server administration.

**Key Competencies**

* Customer focus and service excellence
* Technical troubleshooting and problem-solving
* Ownership and accountability
* Teamwork and collaboration
* Effective communication
* Continuous learning and process improvement

title: Associate Support Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life's other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.

**The Role**

The IT Service Desk Specialist serves as the first point of contact for employees seeking technical assistance and support from Global IT. As a member of the Service Desk team, you will provide exceptional customer service while diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving a wide range of IT issues and service requests.

In this role, you will support users through multiple channels, including phone, email, chat, and ticketing systems, ensuring issues are resolved efficiently or escalated appropriately. You will be responsible for delivering a positive support experience while maintaining service levels, documenting activities accurately, and following established IT processes and procedures.

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, technically inclined, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. They are able to communicate effectively with users at all levels of the organization, demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and take ownership of issues from initial contact through resolution or escalation.

As the face of Global IT support, the Service Desk Specialist plays a critical role in maintaining productivity across the business by providing reliable technical assistance, contributing to knowledge management, and collaborating with teams across the organization to deliver exceptional service.

**What You’ll Do**

**Core Technical Responsibilities**

* Serve as the first point of contact for all IT incidents and service requests through phone, email, chat, and ticketing systems.
* Log, classify, prioritize, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents and requests in accordance with established SLA and ITIL practices.
* Provide first-level technical support for:
* Windows and macOS operating systems
* Microsoft 365 applications (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Password resets and account unlocks
* Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
* Basic Active Directory and Azure Entra user account issues
* Hardware and software troubleshooting
* VPN and remote access connectivity
* Perform initial diagnosis and troubleshooting to achieve first-contact resolution whenever possible.
* Escalate unresolved issues to appropriate Level 2, Level 3, or specialist teams while ensuring complete documentation of troubleshooting activities.
* Monitor service queues and ensure tickets are updated, assigned, and resolved within established service levels.
* Follow knowledge articles, standard operating procedures, and documented troubleshooting guides.
* Create and update knowledge base documentation to support continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
* Maintain accurate ticket documentation, including issue details, troubleshooting performed, and resolution outcomes.
* Identify recurring issues and suggest process improvements to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with IT teams globally to ensure seamless support and service delivery.

**What You’ll Bring**

This person needs to come from a multi-disciplined background and be able to work at all levels within the company on any IT problem or project.

**Specifically:**

**Technical Skills**

* Working knowledge of Windows 10/11 and macOS.
* Basic understanding of Active Directory, Azure Entra ID, and account management concepts.
* Experience supporting Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint.
* Familiarity with ITSM platforms such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, Freshservice, or similar ticketing systems.
* Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including:
* VPN connectivity
* Wi-Fi troubleshooting
* Basic understanding of hardware troubleshooting for laptops, desktops, docking stations, monitors, printers, and mobile devices.
* Understanding of IT security best practices, password management, MFA, and access controls. Experience working with knowledge management tools and documentation platforms.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 2-3 years of experience in a Service Desk, Help Desk, Technical Support, or IT Support role.
* Experience supporting users in a corporate IT environment.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve common hardware, software, and account-related issues.
* Experience working within SLA-driven support environments.
* Strong customer service orientation with a commitment to delivering a positive user experience.
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with global teams.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Associate degree or equivalent experience preferred.
* Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, Microsoft Fundamentals, or similar certifications are considered a plus.

title: AI/ML Expert
description:
Job Description – AI/ML Expert

Position Overview

We are seeking experienced AI/ML professionals from India to join our technology team

in Malaysia. This opportunity is ideal for accomplished AI/ML engineers, data scientists,

machine learning specialists, and applied AI professionals with 5–10 years of relevant

experience who are interested in working on enterprise-grade AI solutions and

contributing to the development of intelligent, scalable, and data-driven applications.

The selected candidate will work closely with engineering, product, data, and business

teams to identify opportunities for applying Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to

real-world business challenges.

The exact designation may be aligned with the candidate’s expertise and experience, such

as AI/ML Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, AI Engineer, Data Scientist, Applied AI

Engineer, or Senior AI/ML Specialist.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, implement, and maintain AI and Machine Learning solutions for

business and technology use cases.

* Analyze complex business problems and translate them into suitable AI/ML

approaches.

* Develop and optimize machine learning models using appropriate algorithms,

frameworks, and techniques.

* Work with structured and unstructured datasets to identify patterns, trends, and

actionable insights.

* Perform data preparation, feature engineering, model training, validation,

evaluation, and optimization.

* Develop production-ready AI/ML pipelines and integrate models into enterprise

applications and platforms.

* Apply techniques such as supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning,

natural language processing, computer vision, recommendation systems,

forecasting, and predictive analytics, depending on project requirements.

* Explore and implement modern Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM)

technologies where relevant.

* Develop solutions involving LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector

databases, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and model

orchestration, where applicable.

* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and models and recommend

appropriate solutions.

* Collaborate with software engineers to deploy AI/ML models into production

environments.

* Monitor model performance, accuracy, scalability, reliability, and data quality after

deployment.

* Identify opportunities to improve model performance through experimentation,

tuning, and continuous learning.

* Design and implement appropriate approaches for model explainability, security,

privacy, and responsible AI.

* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to the design of scalable AI-

enabled applications.

* Work with cloud platforms and modern MLOps practices for model deployment and

lifecycle management.

* Prepare technical documentation covering models, methodologies, architectures,

experiments, and deployment processes.

* Mentor junior engineers/data scientists and contribute to the development of AI/ML

engineering best practices.

* Stay current with developments in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep

Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, and MLOps.

Required Technical Skills

Candidates should have strong practical experience in several of the following areas:

Programming & Data

* Strong proficiency in Python.
* Experience with SQL and relational/non-relational databases.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, statistics, and data analysis.
* Experience with libraries/frameworks such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn,

TensorFlow, PyTorch, or equivalent.

Machine Learning

* Strong understanding of machine learning concepts and algorithms.
* Experience with model development, training, validation, evaluation, and

optimization.

* Hands-on experience with regression, classification, clustering, recommendation,

forecasting, or other relevant ML techniques.

* Knowledge of feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter optimization,

and performance evaluation.

Deep Learning / AI

Experience in one or more of:

* Neural networks and deep learning.
* Natural Language Processing (NLP).
* Computer Vision.
* Speech/Audio AI.
* Time-series analysis.
* Recommendation systems.
* Predictive analytics.
* Generative AI.

Generative AI / LLM

Exposure to or hands-on experience with:

* Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Prompt engineering.
* Embeddings and semantic search.
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Vector databases.
* Fine-tuning or adaptation of foundation models.
* AI agents and tool/function calling.
* LLM evaluation and optimization.
* Frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.

Cloud & MLOps

Experience with one or more cloud platforms:

* Microsoft Azure
* AWS
* Google Cloud Platform

Knowledge of:

* Docker and containerization.
* CI/CD.
* Model deployment and monitoring.
* ML pipelines.
* MLOps practices.
* Kubernetes or equivalent technologies is an advantage.

Experience Requirements

* 5–10 years of overall professional experience, with substantial hands-on

experience in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a closely related field.

* Proven experience developing and implementing AI/ML solutions in real-world or

enterprise environments.

* Experience taking AI/ML models from experimentation/prototype stage through

production deployment is highly desirable.

* Candidates should demonstrate strong practical problem-solving ability rather than

purely academic or theoretical knowledge.

* Experience working in cross-functional or distributed technology teams is

preferred.

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence,

Machine Learning, Data Science, Information Technology, Engineering,

Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.

* Equivalent professional experience and strong technical expertise may also be

considered.

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be particularly valuable:

* Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
* Enterprise AI platforms.
* Azure AI / AWS AI / Google Cloud AI services.
* MLOps and production ML systems.
* NLP and conversational AI.
* Computer vision.
* AI-powered automation.
* Predictive analytics.
* Big Data technologies.
* API development and microservices.
* .NET/Java/Python-based enterprise application integration.
* Experience working with international clients or multinational organizations.

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand business requirements and convert them into practical AI

solutions.

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to explain complex AI/ML concepts to both technical and non-technical

stakeholders.

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multicultural team.
* Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn emerging AI technologies.
* Strong attention to quality, scalability, security, and maintainability.

Location & Mobility

Candidate Source: India

Candidates currently based in India who are willing to relocate to Malaysia will be

considered.

International candidates with relevant experience and the ability to work from Malaysia

may also be considered based on project and employment requirements.

Candidates should be comfortable working with multicultural and geographically

distributed teams.

We are particularly interested in professionals who can demonstrate:

* Strong hands-on AI/ML engineering capability.
* Experience solving complex real-world problems using AI/ML.
* Ability to build scalable, production-ready solutions.
* Good understanding of the complete AI/ML lifecycle.
* Practical experience with modern AI technologies.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and business

stakeholders.

development into senior-level technical ownership are especially encouraged to

Engagement Opportunity

The final role title, responsibilities, technology stack, and seniority will be aligned with the

candidate’s experience, technical specialization, and project requirements.

Potential positions may include:

* Senior AI/ML Engineer
* Machine Learning Engineer
* AI Engineer
* Senior Data Scientist
* Applied AI Engineer
* Generative AI Engineer
* LLM Engineer
* AI/ML Technical Specialist
* AI/ML Architect

Application Requirements

Interested candidates should submit:

* Updated CV/Resume.
* Total years of experience.
* Relevant AI/ML experience.
* Current location in India.
* Current/expected compensation.
* Notice period/availability.
* Willingness to relocate to Malaysia.
* Summary of key AI/ML projects handled.
* Details of relevant technical skills, frameworks, cloud platforms, and AI/ML

technologies.

* GitHub, portfolio, publications, or project links, where applicable.

Equal Opportunity

We encourage applications from qualified AI/ML professionals with diverse technical

backgrounds and industry experience. Selection will be based on relevant skills,

experience, technical capability, and suitability for the assigned project and role.

description:

**Job Description:**

Staff Data Engineer

Individual Contributor, Grade G

About the role

The Staff Data Engineer plays a critical role in shaping, designing and delivering data and AI solutions that translate complex business needs into scalable, secure and reusable capabilities. Operating at staff level, this role provides senior technical leadership across data products, data platforms and AI-enabled solutions, with clear accountability for end-to-end system design, from high-level architecture through to low-level implementation design.

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. The postholder independently identifies problems to solve, leads the technical design of solutions and acts as technical lead across one large-scale or multiple medium-scale delivery workstreams. A strong command of modern engineering patterns and practices is essential, as this role helps set the engineering standard for others to follow.

The role carries clear technical leadership accountability without line management responsibility. It guides delivery teams, influences internal and third-party engineering outcomes, and ensures solutions are well designed, maintainable, secure and fit for enterprise use. The postholder is also expected to mentor others and actively contribute to engineering excellence across the wider team.

You will work with

This role sits within the Finance Technology team and works closely with data engineers, data analysts, AI and software engineers, product managers, architects, cyber, platform and business stakeholder teams. It also partners with central technology and architecture teams to ensure solutions are designed for reuse, interoperability and future scalability, rather than being developed in isolation.

You will deliver



End-to-end system design: Translate high-level architectural direction into detailed, buildable solution designs. This includes decomposing architectural patterns, such as event-driven ingestion, medallion lakehouse and RAG pipelines, into concrete engineering specifications including table schemas, transformation logic, interface contracts, retry and error-handling strategies, SLA thresholds and observability requirements. Produce HLD artefacts that communicate solution intent and platform choices, alongside LLD artefacts that delivery engineers can implement without ambiguity. Design outputs should be reviewable through architecture governance and usable as the baseline for technical assurance.



Strong engineering practices and patterns: Set and reinforce standards for software design, code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability and documentation. Advocate for and apply established engineering patterns, including event-driven architecture, microservices, pipeline orchestration, RAG and layered data architecture, using sound judgement on when each pattern is appropriate. Apply these patterns effectively across data-intensive pipelines, products and applications.



Scalable data infrastructure and product delivery: Design, build and maintain reliable data pipelines, data products and integration layers that move, process and serve data across the enterprise at scale.



AI-enabled solution engineering: Integrate AI and machine learning capabilities into production-grade applications, including LLM-based solutions, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents and unstructured data processing. Evaluate AI tooling pragmatically, prioritising measurable business value and sustainable delivery over experimentation for its own sake.



Technology selection, reuse and scalable solution design: Exercise strong technical judgement in determining when to build custom capability, configure or extend existing platforms, adopt SaaS solutions, or use low-code/no-code approaches. Ensure decisions consider both the immediate requirement and broader enterprise value, balancing delivery speed, maintainability, cost and scalability. Identify opportunities to reuse existing capabilities, create common patterns and shared services, adopt platform-based solutions and actively reduce unnecessary duplication and technical debt.



Technical governance and design assurance: Work with architecture, cyber, data governance and platform teams to ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for security, resilience, compliance, performance and operational readiness.



Engineering leadership across internal and third-party teams: Provide technical direction and engineering leadership across internal teams, delivery partners and third-party suppliers. Set clear engineering expectations, challenge technical decisions where appropriate, and ensure delivered solutions meet required standards for quality, architecture, security, maintainability and long-term ownership.



Operational excellence and lifecycle ownership: Design for supportability, observability, reliability and cost effectiveness throughout the solution lifecycle. Define service reliability expectations, SLA requirements and appropriate site-reliability engineering practices for systems owned or technically led by the role.



Hands-on delivery and prototyping: Translate ambiguous problems into practical technology options, solution designs and working prototypes. Use modern engineering and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate design and

build activities, test assumptions and validate ideas rapidly with users before committing to larger-scale implementation.



Technical mentorship and engineering excellence: Mentor engineers across the team, contribute to data engineering learning and development, and actively participate in the evolution of engineering communities, standards, reusable patterns and practices.

What you will need to be successful

Essential



Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.



8+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, productionising and maintaining reliable, scalable data infrastructure and data products in complex environments.



Demonstrable experience producing HLD and LLD artefacts for data or technology solutions, including solution architecture diagrams, data-flow designs, component specifications, API contracts, data models and operational runbooks.



Ability to take architectural decisions and decompose them into engineering specifications that developers can build from without further clarification.



Strong command of software engineering best practices, including technical design review, unit testing, CI/CD pipeline development, monitoring and alerting, code review and documentation.



Development experience in one or more object-oriented programming languages, with Python preferred. Scala, Java or C# are also applicable.



Expert SQL knowledge and experience working with large-scale distributed data systems.



Experience integrating AI and machine learning capabilities into production systems, including LLMs through APIs, RAG patterns, vector search, embeddings or AI agents.



Deep knowledge and hands-on experience across the full data lifecycle.



Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to lead through technical influence across internal teams and external partners.



A continuous learning and improvement mindset.

Desired



Experience with AI/ML frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, Weaviate or similar ecosystems.



Familiarity with agentic frameworks such as CrewAI, AutoGen or similar LLM orchestration toolkits.



Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Hadoop or Hive.



Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP, and infrastructure-as-code practices.



Experience with data governance tools such as Alation or Collibra, and enterprise data management standards.



No prior experience in the energy industry is required.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  
  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  
  

As the Manager of the Extensibility Platform team at Docusign, you will lead a high-performing, cross-functional engineering team focused on developing and scaling the Extensibility Platform, as well as building new Extension Types and first-party applications. The platform enables internal and external developers to create applications that integrate seamlessly with Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) systems. Developers can publish their applications through the Developer Console, making them available in the Docusign App Center for customers to discover and install. You will bring hands-on technical leadership through coding, code reviews, and driving the design and evolution of engineering architectures. You will help ensure the platform remains scalable, configurable, and capable of supporting diverse business scenarios, while strengthening collaboration and communication across engineering, product, and other partner teams.

This position is a people manager role reporting to the Senior Director, Software Engineering.

**Responsibility**

* Conduct thorough code reviews to maintain code quality, reliability, security, and engineering standards
* Create, review, and drive engineering architectures that enable a scalable, configurable Extensibility Platform
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers on design decisions, implementation approaches, and best practices
* Partner with engineering, product, design, and other teams to align technical solutions with platform and customer needs
* Define and communicate a clear technical vision and strategic roadmap for the Extensibility Platform, emphasizing usability, performance, and scalability
* Work closely with product managers, architects, and other stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver features critical to business success
* Guide the team in producing high-quality, maintainable code, with a strong focus on best practices in testing, monitoring, and logging
* Promote best practices in DevOps, continuous deployment, and Agile methodologies to enhance development efficiency and product quality
* Mentor and develop engineering talent, fostering a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration
* Engage with external developers and partners to expand the ecosystem of integrations available through the Docusign App Center

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  
  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  
  

**Basic**

* 5+ years of software development and management experience across multiple languages/frameworks (or equivalent)
* 5+ years of hands-on coding or equivalent
* 5+ years of leading software teams of 5+ people or equivalent
* Proven track record in building solutions that consume and expose APIs/web services
* Experience in SaaS or Cloud environments

**Preferred**

* Expertise with high-availability (99.99%+) distributed systems
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile methodologies
* Curiosity and adaptability in learning new tech stacks
* Experience building and scaling platform components for app marketplaces or similar ecosystems
* Prior involvement in designing secure, reliable integrations with third-party apps or services
* Experience in integrating with 3rd party enterprise systems
* Experience in building enterprise software and platforms

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

**Accommodation**

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

description:

**Job Description**

You will define and implement the end-to-end security architecture for Databricks on a major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP). This is a hands-on role responsible for the access, governance, and data-protection model across the platform. You have designed and implemented enterprise security controls for Databricks environments, and you will act as a cross-account authority on security guardrails, access governance, and compliance.

What You Will Do

**Own end-to-end security architecture.** Define and implement the security architecture for Databricks across the platform, from identity through data protection.

**Manage identity and access.** Own SSO/MFA integration and RBAC/ABAC access models, and establish access governance processes across accounts and workspaces.

**Secure Unity Catalog.** Design and enforce Unity Catalog security, data classification, and fine-grained access controls (row, column, and attribute level).

**Secure Delta Sharing and open sharing.** Ensure only approved data is exposed across cross-account and open sharing, with reliable, measurable revocation.

**Design least privilege and blast-radius containment.** Establish the lowest practical access boundary, preventing access to adjacent business-unit data and storage.

**Control privileged access and configuration drift.** Govern privileged elevation and break-glass access, and detect unauthorized changes with monitored alert latency and remediation.

**Protect data and secrets.** Establish controls for encryption, secrets management, and network security aligned to relevant regulatory compliance requirements.

**Build guardrails and auditability.** Set up security guardrails, auditability, and access governance so the platform stays compliant and controllable as it scales.

**Provide cross-account technical leadership.** Act as a go-to security reviewer across multiple accounts, contributing to design reviews and resolving access and governance issues that individual delivery teams cannot.

What You Bring (Required)

Hands-on experience designing and implementing security for enterprise Databricks environments.

Deep Unity Catalog security experience: RBAC/ABAC, fine-grained (row/column/attribute) access, data classification, and Delta Sharing / open sharing controls.

Least-privilege and blast-radius design across business units, containing access to adjacent data and storage.

Privileged access management experience: controlled elevation, break-glass, configuration-drift detection, and remediation.

Strong identity and access management background: SSO/MFA integration and access governance.

Expertise in encryption, secrets management, and network security on at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Working knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements relevant to data platforms.

Ability to design and run proof-of-control tests and quantify outcomes (e.g., revocation time, data exposure, drift-detection and alert latency), not just implement.

Nice to Have (Preferred)

Databricks Cloud Platform Architect accreditation (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or Databricks Platform Administrator.

Recognized cloud security certification (e.g., AWS or Azure security specialty, or CISSP). Note that Databricks has no standalone security certification, so security credentials come from the cloud provider or an industry body.

Multi-cloud experience across two or more of AWS, Azure, and GCP.

Regulated-industry experience (financial services, healthcare, or similar).

What This Role Is Not

This is a Databricks-native security and access architect role. It is not a general enterprise or datacenter security role. The right candidate has genuinely designed and implemented access, governance, and data-protection controls inside Databricks environments, distinct from a generalist security engineer without hands-on Databricks depth.

title: Sr Engineer IT Infrastructure Engineering
description:
**Role Purpose**
================

A Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer designs, builds, secures, and scales an organization's core technology systems across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The role combines deep hands-on expertise across enterprise compute, storage, and virtualization with knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS or GCP).

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **System Reliability, Monitoring & Capacity Planning:** Design, build, and maintain highly available, scalable systems across hybrid and cloud environments. Define SLIs/SLOs, build out the monitoring and observability roadmap, and analyze resource usage to forecast and manage capacity as traffic and data grow.
* **Infrastructure as Code, Automation & CI/CD:** Architect and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines and code-driven infrastructure, automating provisioning and reducing manual operational work to enable rapid, safe, and repeatable delivery.
* **Hybrid & Cloud Platform Engineering:** Serve as technical lead for the full lifecycle of on-prem and cloud-based resources — compute, storage, backup, and virtualization — and design secure, cost-effective cloud architectures, including migration of on-premises workloads to the cloud.
* **FinOps & Cost Optimization:** Drive FinOps best practices by monitoring, analyzing, and optimizing cloud spend, including cost allocation and reporting.
* **Advanced Troubleshooting & Incident Response:** Serve as the final escalation point for high-impact technical challenges, providing Tier 3 support and leading incident response to minimize downtime across on-prem and cloud systems.
* **Security & Compliance:** Maintain a strong security baseline across platform and cloud services and ensure compliance with standards such as SOC 2 and PCI-DSS.
* **Mentorship, Collaboration & Documentation:** Guide and mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, and promote SRE/DevOps best practices; partner with development, architecture, and security teams, and maintain comprehensive documentation and standards.

**Key Skills & Qualifications**
===============================

**1. Compute & Storage Skills**
-------------------------------

* 10+ years of progressive IT infrastructure engineering experience, with a proven track record in global enterprise environments.
* Deep, hands-on expertise across Operating Systems (Windows and Linux), enterprise storage, backup (Veeam or similar), and virtualization/hyper-converged systems (Nutanix), including physical infrastructure in on-prem or hybrid environments.
* Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, DNS, VPN, SMTP) and core security practices (SSL/TLS, SSH, encryption, LDAP).
* Experience with configuration management (Chef, Ansible, Puppet) and orchestration platforms (CloudBolt, Rundeck).
* Automation and scripting experience (e.g., Python, Shell, PowerShell) to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.
* Relevant industry certifications (Microsoft, Red Hat, Nutanix, VMware, backup/storage, Cisco, or security-related) are a plus.

**2. Cloud Skills**
-------------------

* Deep, hands-on expertise with at least one major cloud platform (AWS or GCP) — including compute, storage, networking, database, and security services; multi-cloud or hybrid cloud experience preferred.
* Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Azure Resource Manager) and cloud networking concepts (VPCs, subnets, routing, load balancing, DNS, Direct Connect, hybrid connectivity).
* Experience leading migration of on-premises applications and data to the cloud.
* Demonstrated experience driving FinOps strategies to optimize cloud spend without compromising performance or security.
* In-depth knowledge of cloud security best practices and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS).
* Professional-level cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect) are a plus.

**Additional Qualifications**
-----------------------------

* Exceptional analytical and strategic problem-solving skills, with the ability to correlate and troubleshoot complex issues across diverse platforms.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and mentoring skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences, and a solid understanding of the project management lifecycle.

**Education**
=============

Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.

title: Lead DevSecops Engineer
description:
**Summary of This Role**
------------------------

Combines software development and IT operations practices which shorten the systems delivery life cycle and provide a continuous delivery platform and complements the efficiencies of Agile software development methods. Builds and maintains the tooling and infrastructure used to automate the release, deployment, and upgrade processes. Ensures continuous, high velocity delivery and automated deployment through the use of software provisioning, configuration management, source code management and/or team collaboration applications.

**What Part Will You Play?**
----------------------------

* CI/CD Pipeline Development
* Architect and implement automated build, test, and deployment workflows using tools like Harness.io and GitHub Actions.
* Continuously improve pipeline reliability, speed, and maintainability via templating, modularization, and best practices.
* Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) pipelines using Terraform.
* Ensure consistent provisioning and configuration of cloud resources (compute, networking, storage, IAM).
* Operate and optimize components in AWS or Google Cloud Platform
* Monitor cost, performance, and security posture; recommend and implement improvements.
* Work hand-in-hand with application teams to onboard services onto CI/CD pipelines, define branching strategies, and automate release gates.
* Partner with security and compliance teams to bake in policies (e.g., vulnerability scans, secret management) into pipelines.
* Build reusable pipeline templates and shared libraries to accelerate delivery across teams.
* Integrate testing frameworks (unit, integration, security) and observability tools (logging, metrics, tracing) into workflows.
* Diagnose and resolve pipeline failures, infrastructure provisioning errors, or environment drift.
* Monitor and triage security vulnerabilities identified by platforms such as Wiz and Macroscope; partner with engineering and security stakeholders to drive remediation efforts.
* Collaborate with security teams to integrate automated vulnerability detection and reporting into CI/CD pipelines.
* Configure and maintain secure and reliable log forwarding from application and infrastructure layers to observability platforms such as Splunk.
* Helps other developers on the team with technical issues and onboard them to the frameworks
* Partner with development and other project teams to improve the systems process and provide the necessary support with day to day operations
* Migrate older technology implementations to modern a container/Kubernetes platform
* Ensure logs meet compliance, audit, and monitoring requirements; help define and enforce logging standards across environments.
* Primary contributions in Development, Testing Frameworks and Rollout.
* Works under the guidance of Lead Software Engineers, Tech Leads and Architects.
* Research trends in the current technology domain, discover new tools and garner the consensus for internal adoption
* Mentor and train junior and mid-level engineers on the team; assists with technical issues and onboard them to the frameworks

**What Are We Looking For in This Role?**
-----------------------------------------

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a technical discipline
* Typically Minimum of 6 years years of experience in IT with expertise in complex technology solutions

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with policy-as-code tools (OPA, policy frameworks).Exposure to security automation (vulnerability scanning, secrets management).
* Understanding of Git branching strategies (GitFlow, trunk-based development).
* GCP/Azure cloud certification
* SAFe certified
* Working with remote teams (onshore, nearshore, offshore)
* Experience with managing a large code base that is a mixture of legacy code and modern technology, preferably experience with moving legacy code to the cloud
* Experience with SF DX
* Experience with continuous integration build engines, such as Jenkins

**What Are Our Desired Skills and Capabilities?**
-------------------------------------------------

* Skills / Knowledge - Having wide-ranging experience, uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways. Some barriers to entry exist at this level (e.g., dept./peer review).
* Job Complexity - Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. Exercises judgment in selecting methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Networks with key contacts outside own area of expertise.
* Supervision - Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel (Team Lead).

* Hands-on experience in functional, integration, regression and end-to-end testing.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP and core networking concepts.
* Experience testing REST APIs and interpreting JSON request and response data.
* Programming or test-automation experience using Python.
* Exposure to UI automation using Playwright, Selenium or an equivalent tool.

title: Principal / Lead Python Architect
description:
**Job Title:** Principal Python Software Architect / Staff Engineer

**Department:** Software Engineering & Platform Operations

**Experience Level:** 12 – 18 Years

**Location:** [City, Country / Hybrid / Remote]

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Purpose

We are seeking a visionary **Principal / Lead Python Software Architect** with 12 to 18 years of hands-on technical and leadership experience to lead the architectural evolution, performance optimization, and technical strategy of our enterprise platform.

In this role, you will design resilient, scalable distributed systems, modernize legacy backend pipelines, establish enterprise-wide Python engineering standards, and integrate cutting-edge asynchronous processing, data processing, or AI/ML workloads into our core infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities1. Enterprise Architecture & System Design

* **Distributed Systems Design:** Architect, scale, and maintain fault-tolerant, low-latency, and high-concurrency microservices architectures using modern **Python (3.11/3.12+)**.
* **Framework & Ecosystem Mastery:** Architect complex web services, REST/gRPC APIs, and asynchronous message-driven systems using **FastAPI, Django, Flask, Asyncio, Celery, and RabbitMQ/Kafka**.
* **Modernization & Refactoring:** Drive migration and refactoring strategies from legacy backend monoliths into scalable, cloud-native microservices or event-driven frameworks.
* **AI/Data Pipeline Integration:** Oversee the architectural integration of machine learning models, vector databases, semantically indexed search engines, or LLM workflows into production systems.

2. Engineering Governance, Security & Performance

* **Performance Engineering:** Troubleshoot deep memory leaks, event loop bottlenecks, and execute CPU/IO profiling to achieve ultra-low latency and efficient memory management.
* **Database Architecture:** Design, optimize, and manage high-volume relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis) databases, including complex query optimization and sharding/partitioning strategies.
* **Security & Compliance:** Enforce enterprise-grade security standards (OWASP, OAuth2/OIDC, data encryption at rest/in transit, zero-trust backend architecture).
* **Code Excellence & CI/CD:** Establish automated testing standards (PyTest), static analysis tools (Mypy, Ruff, Black), and containerized CI/CD deployment automation (Docker, Kubernetes).

3. Leadership, Mentorship & Technical Strategy

* **Technical Roadmap:** Collaborate closely with the CTO, Product Managers, and Executive Leadership to translate long-term business strategy into robust tech roadmaps.
* **Engineering Mentorship:** Lead, mentor, and elevate Technical Leads, Senior Engineers, and cross-functional engineering teams, fostering a strong culture of innovation and engineering rigor.
* **Vendor & Tooling Evaluation:** Evaluate and select third-party cloud tools, frameworks, and infrastructure services to maximize operational efficiency and cost ROI.

Technical Qualifications & Requirements

* **Total Experience:** 12 to 18 years of progressive software engineering experience, with **8+ years dedicated to Python backend development** at massive scale.
* **Core Python Expertise:** Deep internal mastery of Python (Memory Management, GIL internals, Asyncio, Multiprocessing, Metaclasses, Generators, and Type Hinting).
* **Backend Stack:** Proven expertise in **FastAPI / Django / Flask**, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic, gRPC, RESTful APIs, and GraphQL.
* **Concurrency & Message Queues:** Hands-on experience with asynchronous task processing via Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery, or Redis Pub/Sub.
* **Databases & Caching:** Mastery of PostgreSQL / MySQL query optimization, schema design, and caching layers (Redis, Memcached).
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:** Hands-on experience with cloud environments (**AWS / GCP / Azure**), Docker, Kubernetes, Serverless architectures, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform / CloudFormation).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical industry experience.

Soft Skills & Leadership Profile

* **Strategic Business Acumen:** Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs with business ROI, cost, and time-to-market top of mind.
* **Executive Communication:** Skilled at presenting complex architectural concepts clearly to both technical engineers and non-technical C-suite executives.
* **Crisis Management:** Decisive leadership during major production outages, complex security incidents, or critical release cycles.

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹2,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Enterprise Technology Engineer
description:
**Entity:**

Technology  

**Job Family Group:**

IT&S Group  

**Job Description:**

**You will work with**

You will lead a high-energy, top-performing team of engineers and product managers, working alongside technology and business leaders to shape the vision and drive the execution of progressive platform initiatives that make a real impact.

  
  

**Let me tell you about the role**

The Senior Enterprise Technology Engineer provides engineering leadership across bp's digital landscape, connecting squads with bp's platforms and engineering capabilities to deliver high-quality, scalable, and resilient solutions aligned to business strategy. They lead end-to-end technical delivery, ensure engineering integrity at scale, and actively manage delivery and technical risk while guiding teams through complex build challenges.

Operating as a hands-on technical leader with strong customer and stakeholder influence, they balance long-term engineering excellence with near-term delivery outcomes, empowering squads to make sound technical decisions and fostering a unified, pragmatic, and sustainable engineering culture across bp.

This role will play a key leadership position in delivering modern B2B customer portal and commerce capabilities, working closely with customer engagement platforms, product teams, architecture teams, SAP teams, and engineering squads to maximise reuse of shared platform capabilities and accelerate delivery through modern composable architecture principles.

  
  

**What you will deliver**

  
  

**Technology**

Leads a team of enterprise engineers to design, develop, and deliver high-quality platforms and services. Acts as a hands-on technical authority on bp's platforms, languages, and frameworks, including Node.js, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, cloud-native architectures, and enterprise integration patterns. Drives squad goals, prioritises initiatives, and delivers in a product-led, empowered environment. Guides modernisation of legacy estates to unlock future capabilities.

  
  

**Delivery & Transformation**

Owns end-to-end delivery of complex B2B commerce and customer portal transformation programmes, from discovery through build, migration, cutover, and hypercare. Manages delivery risk, sequencing, and dependencies across squads, vendors, and SI partners. Ensures legacy-to-modern transitions are planned for coexistence, data migration, and minimal business disruption.

Drives adoption of MACH and composable architecture principles, ensuring alignment with strategic customer engagement platforms through reuse of shared capabilities, APIs, services, and design patterns.

  
  

**Data**

Engineers data-intensive solutions and integration flows across enterprise systems. Builds secure, governed, and interoperable data pipelines with strong quality, lineage, and observability. Designs and governs API-led and event-driven integration architectures using REST, GraphQL, OData, SAP integration patterns, and enterprise messaging solutions.

  
  

**Commercial Awareness**

Applies engineering insight to cost and value priorities, including cloud spend and TCO. Evaluates tools and platforms for fit, resilience, and lock-in risk to inform build-vs-buy decisions.

  
  

**Safety, Security & Compliance**

Embeds secure-by-design practices and supports audit, licensing, and compliance obligations as part of routine delivery.

  
  

**Collaboration & Influence**

Acts as a technical expert, providing guidance and support to the squad and wider engineering community. Communicates clearly with team members, partners, and customers. Represents engineering in governance and design forums to resolve technical trade-offs.

Leads and governs delivery partners, system integrators, and product vendors, ensuring architectural and engineering standards are upheld across the extended delivery ecosystem.

Works closely with Product, UX, Architecture, SAP, Integration, and Platform teams to ensure solutions align with strategic platform roadmaps and maximise reuse of common capabilities and technical assets.

  
  

**Building Teams**

Shapes squad structures, tech-lead roles, and engineering capacity for complex programmes. Develop an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture through technical leadership and collaboration.

  
  

**Growing People**

Mentors engineers across grades and supports succession planning. Promotes standard methodologies, maintainable code, clear documentation, and high-quality work.

  
  

**Change Leadership**

Leads engineering transformation and adoption of modern practices, including DevSecOps, SRE, platform engineering, cloud-native delivery, composable architecture, and AI-assisted development. Ensures quality in enterprise platform engineering at the squad level and owns the engineering narrative for change.

  
  

**What you will need to be successful**

  
  

**Technical Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 12+ years of experience in enterprise technology, security, and operations in large-scale global environments, with 4+ years in a technical leadership role delivering cloud-native, MACH (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless), composable architecture, and customer-facing digital platform solutions.
* Strong experience building, leading, and running high-performance engineering teams, with a focus on reliability, automation, operational excellence, and customer success.
* Deep knowledge of ITIL, Agile, DevSecOps, and enterprise technology governance frameworks.
* Hands-on software engineering experience, including test driven development, automated testing, CI/CD, code quality management, and modern engineering practices.
* Strong understanding of B2B commerce and customer portal capabilities, including Product Catalog Management, Product Modelling, Inventory Availability, Shopping Cart and Checkout, Order Management, Search and Browse, SEO, and Personalisation.
* Strong experience integrating customer engagement and commerce platforms with SAP ERP/S/4HANA using IDoc, BAPI, OData, RFC, SAP CPI/BTP, APIs, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Strong technical expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, JavaScript, relational databases, microservices, BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) patterns, API orchestration, API gateways, and modern distributed system design.

title: Data Architect (Ontologist / Knowledge Graph)
description:
Hiring: Semantic Data Architect (Ontologist / Knowledge Graph)

**Company:** PyxTech  
**Experience:** 7–10 Years  
**Salary:** Competitive  
**Location:** Remote (India)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Working Days:** 5 Days a Week  
**Shift:** US Time Zone Overlap  
**Notice Period:** Maximum 30 Days  
**Openings:** 1

About PyxTech

PyxTech is a B2B SaaS and AI technology company specializing in enterprise software, AI-powered solutions, digital engineering, and technology consulting. We help organizations modernize enterprise architecture, automate workflows, and unlock business value through intelligent data and AI solutions.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Semantic Data Architect / Ontologist** with strong expertise in enterprise ontology development, RDF-based semantic modeling, and knowledge graph architecture.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing enterprise ontologies, building semantic data models, connecting fragmented enterprise data sources, and implementing W3C semantic web standards to support enterprise search, analytics, and AI-driven applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic knowledge models.
* Build RDF-based semantic data structures using RDF, RDFS, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Integrate data from multiple enterprise systems into connected knowledge graphs.
* Develop and manage controlled vocabularies, metadata models, and taxonomy lifecycle processes.
* Implement SHACL-based data validation and constraints, along with SKOS for knowledge organization.
* Deploy and manage knowledge graphs using Neo4j, GraphDB, Amazon Neptune, or Stardog.
* Work with ontology and taxonomy management platforms such as PoolParty and TopBraid EDG.
* Optimize semantic models for enterprise search, analytics, metadata extraction, and AI applications.
* Collaborate with data engineers, AI/ML teams, developers, and business stakeholders.
* Support cloud-based deployments using AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes.

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

* 7+ years of overall IT/data experience.
* **Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience specifically in RDF-based semantic ontology development and modeling.**
* Strong expertise in enterprise ontology design, taxonomy development, and semantic metadata management.
* Expert knowledge of RDF, RDFS, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Practical experience with SHACL and SKOS.
* Production experience with at least one graph database: Neo4j, GraphDB, Amazon Neptune, or Stardog.
* Hands-on experience with at least one ontology/taxonomy management platform, such as PoolParty, TopBraid EDG, or GraphDB (Ontotext).
* Familiarity with AWS, Docker, or Kubernetes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work with globally distributed teams and overlap with US business hours.
* Maximum notice period of 30 days.

Preferred Skills

* NLP, Named Entity Recognition (NER), and semantic metadata extraction.
* Experience with spaCy or similar NLP tools.
* Experience supporting enterprise search, knowledge discovery, and AI-driven applications.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Library Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

Interview Process

* HR Screening and Initial Evaluation
* Client Technical Assessment / Deep Dive
* Client Final / Behavioral Interview

How to Apply

If you have strong hands-on experience in RDF-based ontology engineering, semantic data architecture, and enterprise knowledge graphs, we would love to hear from you.

**Please apply with your updated resume highlighting your ontology projects, RDF experience, graph database expertise, and notice period.**

**Important:** This role requires substantial practical ontology engineering experience, not just general data architecture or basic knowledge of graph databases.

This role is for a software engineering director who leads a high-performing team of software engineers building AI-native and cloud-native applications on the ServiceNow platform. The Director combines deep technical credibility with strong people management capabilities, fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. They are responsible for team performance, career development, hiring, and execution of key business initiatives. This role requires the ability to balance people development with business results, think strategically about AI integration and platform architecture, and influence across the organization to enable team success. The ideal candidate brings experience scaling AI-native teams and a passion for building leaders.

**What we do** - Finance and Procurement teams are at the forefront of AI-native engineering at ServiceNow—building autonomous solutions for the world's largest enterprises that handle mission-critical financial and procurement operations at unprecedented scale. They continuously learn and integrate the latest AI and cloud-native technologies to deliver performant, resilient systems that transform how businesses manage supplier lifecycles, procurement workflows, payments, and receivables.

**Responsibility Area: People Leadership & Development**

* Build, grow, and maintain a high-performing, diverse team of IC2-IC5 engineers; hire and develop talent at all levels
* Set clear expectations for individual and team performance; establish metrics and goals aligned with business objectives
* Conduct regular 1:1s with direct reports; provide coaching, feedback, and career guidance tailored to each engineer's growth stage
* Create a culture of psychological safety, learning, and ownership; encourage experimentation and learning from failures
* Support engineers through career transitions—from IC2 to IC3, IC3 to IC4, and technical-to-management pathways
* Identify high-potential engineers and invest in their development; prepare emerging leaders for increased responsibility
* Address performance issues promptly and professionally; provide clear paths for improvement or transition
* Sponsor team members for growth opportunities, stretch assignments, and leadership development programs
* Celebrate wins and recognize contributions; foster a positive, collaborative team environment
* Model vulnerability, continuous learning, and AI-native thinking; lead by example in your own growth

* Lead technical interviews and assessments for engineering candidates at all IC levels; make hiring decisions
* Partner with HR and recruiting teams on job descriptions, sourcing strategies, and candidate pipeline management

* Build a team with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives; actively work to improve representation
* Identify gaps in team capabilities (technical depth, domain expertise, AI/ML fluency) and address through hiring or development
* Build relationships with external technical communities to attract and recruit top talent
* Participate in employer branding and represent the organization at recruiting events and universities

* Ensure the team's technical approach stays current with AI/ML advancements and ServiceNow platform evolution

* Advocate for technical investments (refactoring, infrastructure, tooling) that improve team productivity and code quality

* Foster a culture of ownership where engineers take responsibility for quality, testing, and production outcomes

* Participate in engineering leadership meetings; contribute to organizational strategy and policy
* Promote psychological safety, inclusion, and belonging; actively work to reduce barriers for underrepresented groups
* Foster knowledge sharing across the organization; encourage your team to contribute to brown bags, documentation, and communities
